title: AutoOS AI model registry
description: Single hand-edited model file (docs/plans/2026-09-25-routing-v2-spec.md section 3). Generated by tools/registry-convert.py from the old catalog/config files during migration phase 1; a later phase makes this the only hand-edited source and deletes them (D11). Sections: providers, models, routes, clients, policy - exactly section 3.1's list. Measured values (probes, recalibrate) never write this file; they live in the git-ignored overlay logs/routing/measured.json.

version.description: Registry content date (YYYY-MM-DD), bumped whenever a hand edit or a re-run of registry-convert.py changes the file.

providers.description: One entry per upstream provider (spec 3.1). Keyed by provider id (the api-keys.yml name, e.g. 'google_ai_studio'; 'antigravity' and 'cc' are OAuth/subscription bridges with no api-keys.yml entry).

models.description: One entry per upstream model (spec 3.1). Keyed by the exact model-id spelling a route leg uses after its provider prefix (providers spell the same real model differently - e.g. groq's 'openai/gpt-oss-120b' vs cerebras's 'gpt-oss-120b' - so those are two distinct entries; see docs/plans/2026-09-25-registry-mapping.md Open choices).

routes.description: One entry per combo / fallback group / pinned single-model route (spec 3.1). Keyed by route id (== configuration/omniroute/combos.json combo name, or the catalog/ide-models.json id for surfaces with no combos.json equivalent).

clients.description: One entry per agent CLI (spec 3.1): opencode, claude, qwen, gemini, codex, agy, qoder.

comment.description: Prose that belongs with the data next to it (D9/D20: don't lose a measured fact). A single line or a list of lines, same convention as the old catalogs' $comment arrays.

source_tag.description: D20: default (unmeasured), probe (overlay-measured), or the ISO date a measurement/decision was made.

sourced_number.description: The one consistent shape (D20) for a policy number that is not itself a data table: the value plus where it came from.

window.description: providers.<id>.windows entry (spec 6.4). price_factor is a multiplier on the baseline price (1.0 = no change); kind distinguishes a genuine price window (DeepSeek) from an informational load window (Anthropic/Meta busy hours, price_factor 1.0) carried over from provider-windows.json so that fact is not lost.

api_base.description: Public vendor endpoint only (registry.py check rejects private hosts/IPs/usernames, spec 3.1).

available.description: Additive field, not in spec 3.1: operator decision 2026-09-25 (OpenRouter not topped up) needs a way to mark a provider unusable without deleting or reordering its data - see routes.<id>.unavailable_legs for the matching per-leg flag. Omitted (not false) means available.

trains_on_prompts.description: Provider-level (spec 3.1), not per-model - a known simplification where one provider hosts both a training and a non-training leg; see mapping doc Open choices.

direct.description: today's llm-models.json direct-provider block: access that bypasses the OmniRoute gateway entirely (opencode's own provider catalog).

display_name.description: Additive field, not in spec 3.1: llm-models.json's human-readable 'name'. Kept so it is not lost (D9); routes carry their own per-surface display_name separately.

default_for.description: Additive field, not in spec 3.1: llm-models.json's opencode default-selection key (e.g. which api-key condition makes this model opencode's default). Kept so it is not lost (D9); it is an opencode.jsonc rendering concern, not consumed by the resolver.

family.description: anthropic/google/deepseek/meta/qwen/openai-oss/mistral/cohere/... (spec 3.1's list is open-ended; extra vendor families used here: nvidia, poolside, nex-agi, thinkingmachines, dots-studio, inclusionai, zhipu, moonshot, minimax, openrouter).

effort_ladder.description: Ordered rungs, e.g. ["none","low","medium","high","xhigh"]. Empty for a non-reasoning model.

paid_price_in.description: Additive field, not in spec 3.1: the post-free-cap price on llm-models.json entries that are free only under a cap (paid_input_price). Kept so the fact is not lost (D9); price_in/price_out stay the free-tier price.

client_bound.description: e.g. 'opencode' for the Zen free contributor leg, which 403s proxied traffic.

trains_on_prompts.description: Additive field, not in spec 3.1: an optional model-level override of providers.<id>.trains_on_prompts (PRIV brief, 2026-09-26), for a provider that hosts both a training and a non-training model (e.g. mistral-code-latest: true, on the otherwise non-training paid 'mistral' provider). Missing means inherit the provider's own value - see tools/registry.py's private_safe().

tier.description: Additive field, not in spec 3.1: an optional model-level override of providers.<id>.tier (PRIV2 brief, 2026-09-26), for a provider that hosts both a free/training pool and a paid, direct-key model under the same provider tier (e.g. the zen provider's own tier is 'free', but its opencode-zen/deepseek-v4.1-flash leg bills past the pool on the same key - the model-level override marks that leg 'paid'). Missing means inherit the provider's own value - see tools/registry.py's private_safe().

leg.description: provider/model: the part before the first '/' is a providers id or omniroute_id, the rest is a models id.

surface.description: One of routes.<id>.surfaces['omniroute'|'litellm'|'opencode'|'zed'|'openhands'] (spec 3.1: display name, context/output declared, effort default, OpenHands profile fields). Keyed by gateway (omniroute/litellm) here, per catalog/ide-models.json's own shape, with the exposing UI surfaces nested under 'clients' - see mapping doc Open choices.

context_declared.description: combos.json's coarse display string ('1M'/'128k'/'200k') for the omniroute surface - a picker/compaction convention, not the model's real window (see docs/models.md).

openhands_profile.description: configuration/openhands/tier-profiles.json fields for this surface (max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens, reasoning, and gateway/base_url when the profile bypasses the default gateway).

direct_profile.description: An OpenHands profile with no ide-models.json surface counterpart (e.g. the direct-OpenRouter spark profile with the full effort ladder).

unavailable_legs.description: Additive field, not in spec 3.1: operator decision 2026-09-25 (OpenRouter not topped up) marks the affected legs here by their exact routes.<id>.legs string, without removing or reordering them (spec 3.2 phase-1 equality gate).

skills_dir.description: Null where the native skills directory is still unmeasured (plan Phase C5 spike).

signin_check.description: 'env:<NAME>' for a gateway client (presence check), the literal probe command for a client tools/autoos_clients.py already probes (agy), or null where no probe exists yet.

policy.description: spec section 5: modes/theta/lambda (5.4), bucket table (5.2), effort rules (5.5), handoff caps (8.3), risk rules (5.7), seed priors and latency seed (5.6), verify/brief tokens (5.3). Every numeric value not itself part of a pinned data table (bucket_table) carries a source (D20).

modes.description: spec 5.4: theta (min success probability to pick a route) and lambda (USD per minute of wall clock) per mode.

bucket_table.description: The exact shape of tools/autoos_resolver.py DEFAULT_BUCKET_TABLE (spec 5.2), wrapped once with a source tag so the inner 'table' stays byte-identical for the resolver to load directly. tests keys are JSON-safe 'true'/'false' strings; a loader must convert them back to booleans before calling points()/bucket().

effort_rules.description: spec 5.5: first-matching-row table plus the reasoning-leg max_tokens floors.

risk_rules.description: spec 5.7: what auto-raises risk to high. Two rule shapes: a path glob matched against the card's declared paths, or a diff-shape trigger (a deletion anywhere in the diff).
